title: Cedarway Pharmacy conversational pilot - intake jot
content:
Quick capture from kickoff/technical intake with Cedarway Pharmacy (regional retail pharmacy chain) - informal notes, rough requirements and open questions. Not polished.

Attendees:
- Cedarway: Claire Hsu (PM), Omar Rahman (Infra lead), Lina Brooks (Clinical compliance)
- Redwood: Ariana (CSE, owner), Diego (Solutions Eng), Priya (Security SME)

TL;DR:
- Goal: proof-of-concept conversational assistant for in-store pharmacists and phone triage to reduce simple call volume (refills, hours, OTC guidance).
- Hard constraints: PHI-touching flows require VPC/private deployment; Cedarway wants encrypted KV cache, audit logs, and HSM/KMS integration.
- SLO targets: median latency <= 250ms for single-turn question; 95th percentile <= 750ms during peak (store-hours). Cost sensitivity: target < $0.004 per user interaction (incl embeddings).

Use cases prioritized:
1) Refill status lookup from backend (SaaS Rx system) -> structured tool call to fetch status and estimated ready time.
2) Simple clinical guidance (OTC) with disclaimers and escalation steps. Clinical content must be auditable and model versioned.
3) Ask hours/location/store inventory quick checks (read-only system calls).
4) Triage for telephone line -> escalate to human when uncertain/confidence < threshold.

Technical notes / requirements:
- Deployment: Cedarway demands Private deployment (VPC) for initial pilot. They want the control plane on Redwood-managed, but inference inside their VPC (private connect).
- Auth: SSO via Okta, and token exchange flow during setup. We need to document OIDC client setup and role mappings.
- KMS/HSM: Must support AWS KMS CMK usage and HSM-backed keys for audit.
- Data retention: Audit logs stored 3 years offsite, but short-term token traces (30 days) for debugging. Need redact policy for PHI.
- Model behavior: They want model locked to a verified base (open model candidate: Llama v2 13B quantized variant) and no internet access in private mode. Model must be pinned and rollout via canary.
- Embeddings: For store FAQ & SOP retrieval - initial corpus ~75k docs (per-store short policies + FAQ). Precompute dense embeddings; store in Pinecone-like vector store they host in VPC.
- Caching: KV prefix caching for session continuity to keep latency low on follow-up questions.
- Rate shaping: Expected ~1.2 qps per active store at peak (150 stores pilot) -> plan for batching patterns and prewarm.

Prompting / safety / compliance:
- All clinical suggestions must append a fixed disclaimer and cite SOP doc IDs when used. Want deterministic citations where possible.
- PII/PHI redaction: when user enters PHI in chat, system should 1) mask in logs by default, 2) allow audit view in secure console for authorized roles only. Need a simple redact utility before storing transcripts.
- Approval: Lina (Clinical compliance) will review prompt templates and a small set (50) of eval prompts to sign off. Need evaluation harness before model change.

Open questions / gotchas called out by Cedarway:
- Inventory system API: call rate limits unknown; Omar to share API docs. Need fallback if inventory API times out (return cached store-level snapshot).
- Offline stores: some edge kiosks have intermittent connectivity; how to handle assistant degrade mode? Possible local LM? They are not ready for on-device models; prefer graceful fallback message.
- Billing model: They expect a flat monthly pilot fee + usage meter; commercial will negotiate but engineering should generate cost projection for expected 150 stores, 10k interactions/day.
- Tokenization estimate: avg prompt+response ~ 350 tokens. Need to validate with sample transcripts.

Initial architecture sketch (high-level):
- User (web kiosk or phone agent UI) -> Redwood private endpoint (in their VPC) -> routing layer -> model worker pool pinned to Llama v2 13B quantized -> vector DB + downstream tool adapters (Rx system, inventory) inside VPC.
- Observability: per-route latency and token breakdown shipped to Redwood Console (obfuscated) + full audit logs to Cedarway S3 (encrypted).

Prompt template (working):
- system: "You are Cedarway Assistant. Use store SOPs and clinical guidelines. If you reference medical guidance, include SOP ID. Do not provide diagnoses; only OTC advice and escalation steps.
- user: <customer utterance>
- function: fetch_refill_status(store_id, rx_number) -> then format reply: 'Refill for Rx #... is READY / IN_PROCESS / UNKNOWN (ETA: x) — SOP: SOP-RX-234'

Minimal eval plan:
- 50 replayed real calls (anonymized) -> check correct tool routing (refill vs inventory) and hallucination rate (should be < 2%).
- 200 synthetic prompts for clinical guidance -> check presence of SOP citation and correct disclaimer.

Action items / next steps (owners, tentative dates):
- Omar to share API docs and sample data dump (inventory + refill) by 2024-11-12. (owner: Omar)
- Redwood: produce cost projection + infra sketch for 150-store pilot by 2024-11-15. (owner: Diego)
- Redwood security: draft redact policy & KMS integration checklist by 2024-11-14. (owner: Priya)
- Lina to provide compliance checklist for clinical copy by 2024-11-20. (owner: Lina)
- Set up a short eval harness repo (redwood/pilot-cedarway-evals) and seed with 50 anonymized transcripts by 2024-11-18. (owner: Ariana)

Notes to self (Ari):
- Keep prompt templates minimal and rely on tool outputs for factual fields (ETA, status) to reduce hallucinations.
- Precompute per-store embedding clusters to speed nearest-neighbor retrieval; avoid sending full SOP text to model when possible (use snippet+citation).
- Consider enabling streaming for UI to meet median latency target. Evaluate cost/latency tradeoffs in projection.

Unresolved decisions for commercial/legal:
- NDA / data use terms: Cedarway requests 'no model training on their data' clause. Legal to review; propose 'no fine-tuning with customer data' + telemetry allowed for ops.
- Support SLA: pilot wants 99.5% uptime. Need to confirm whether Redwood private offering can commit or if limited SLA applies.

Misc quick links / refs (for follow-up):
- Slack thread with Cedarway commercial: https://slack.redwood.com/archives/C03CEDARWAY/p1678421
- Confluence seed: /display/PILOTS/Cedarway+Pharmacy+Pilot
- Jira intake ticket: JIRA-8732 (pilot intake)

End of jot. Will convert to a cleaner intake doc after Omar shares API docs. Keep this as working scratchpad.
